profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I code to solve problems and develop marketable products, tools, and features that make a difference. 

I am skilled in using JavaScript(ES6+), ServiceNow, Databricks, React/React Hooks, Node.js, Express.js, SQL (PostgreSQL), REST API, Git, HTML, and CSS. In general, I am passionate about Software Engineering because of the diverse skillset and knowledge required to create a complete application. I love the idea of designing a customized application while collaborating with fellow engineers. We all have a different strategy but technically communicate the most efficient way to achieve our goals while staying creative. 

Please feel free to contact me via LinkedIn! I would love to chat with others about their tech passions and aspirations while having a cortadito or tea.

Find me on GitHub at https://github.com/can619

positions.title: Software Developer/ Consultant
positions.description:
▶ Partnered with the client to gather integration documentation and develop data validation within an HR onboarding application leading to the successful hiring of around 3,500 federal employees and about a 10% decrease in help desk tickets
▶ Enabled the application to be utilized by another bureau of specialists, significantly increasing the platform's user base
▶  Devised a strategy empowering the client to edit 28 offer letters in production, reducing the wait for edits to apply in production from 4 weeks to instantaneously
▶ Successfully educated and registered 20 new hires for ServiceNow courses, setting them on the path to certification and enhancing project placement efficiency
▶ Onboarded 6 developers onto the team by providing trainings and creating technical documentation
▶ Performed peer reviews and story feedback, resulting in less bugs and increased code quality
▶ Led meetings between the functional and developer teams before deployments to prepare documentation, allowing the team to deliver sprint development on time for the client
positions.insights: Skills: ServiceNow · ServiceNow Administration · AngularJS · Software Deployment · Technology Integration

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
▶ Built and maintained full-stack applications using Javascript and Node which contributed to 10k in-person users and $100k sales during launch
▶ Decreased menu-related tickets from 5  to 0 per wk by applying React to render product data requested from the inventory management API
▶ Proactively identified, discussed, and fixed issues within a complex system in an organized fashion while integrating requested features and upgrades
▶ Coordinated installation and testing of software during deployment onto Raspberry Pi 4 computers and touch screens via Cloudflare cloud platform
▶ Collaborated with operations managers to tailor application features and upgrades, resulting in stores increasing their profit margin by 25%
▶ Contributed to stores opening 60 min earlier by eliminating duplicate work by using Node.js and Express to automate HTTP requests for inventory
▶ Partnered with designers, product owners, and developers to scale and design the next generation touch screen menu upgrades 
▶ Designed and researched system architecture, application design, and database design for new e-commerce platform
▶ Incorporated sidebar product filtering, sorting, and searching, allowing a quick and informed shopping experience customizable by the user
▶ Proposed client side rendering to load the menu quickly, make it immediately interactive to in-store customers, and cache data in case of outages
▶ Embraced Agile development involving sprints, expedited deadlines and outlining project scopes and database schema within a lean environment
▶ Demonstrated mindful software development best practices, clean coding principles, and error handling while developing menu from scratch

positions.title: Order Book - Coinbase Pro level 2
positions.description:
▶Order Book is an electronic list of financial exchange data used to keep track of buy and sell orders and price levels, helping investors make informed decisions. 
▶Promoted consistency and reduced latency by utilizing the Coinbase Pro level 2  channel feed via websocket to access real time exchange data 
▶Instantly updated the bid and sell queues while allowing the user to visually configure the chart and table designed using React, Recharts, and CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▶  Built a performance developer tool that generates a Svelte visual component hierarchy tree and a component rendering metrics display for Svelte applications within a Visual Studio Code extension API to track component rendering, re-rendering and provide error messages

▶ Favored React over Svelte because it is supported by a large knowledgeable, enterprise community and integrates various libraries

▶ Applied React to persist data in a maintainable fashion from Svelte components and files, allowing the rendering of the component tree 

▶ Leveraged the Svelte-parser node package to generate a Svelte abstract syntax tree, required to construct a recursive parsing algorithm to filter through Svelte child nodes of the syntax tree data structure and reduce the time complexity of the component search 

▶ Invoked React Hooks to improve efficiency, modularity, and simplicity of code by managing state within components throughout the recursive parsing algorithm, enabling rendering of the appropriate components regardless of level of nesting within the syntax tree

▶ Created an alias cache of the imported components and file paths, which minified and uglified the code, allowing for performance optimization by reducing the load time of the component tree visualizer and decreasing code

▶ Constructed a test Svelte application with nested components to judge the accuracy of the recursive component tree visualizer algorithm

▶ Utilized WebView panels inside of the ReSvelte VSCode extension to allow increased control over customizing the UI, advanced configuration options, and provide a joined workspace by allowing continuation of debugging while still in the code editor; debugged with Node.js runtime

▶ Embraced React Testing Library to prevent unintended consequences in codebase  and  encourage maintainable, readable, modular code  

▶ Product developed under tech accelerator OS Labs (opensourcelabs.io)
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Node.js · JavaScript · Design Patterns

positions.title: Code Translator || Quiz Assists Engineers in Learning Python
positions.description:
▶ Created reusable randomly generated questions in React, building independent components that can handle both UI and logic simultaneously while following a unidirectional data flow; managed state of the user login credentials, forging a reliable and updatable state.

▶ Queried user info and quiz scores due to their relationship, fitting a schema, in an organized table using PostgreSQL relational database, guaranteeing validity, consistent data changes, prevention of data loss, and individual transactions compared to a non-relational database

positions.title: Babel Chat || Real-time Language Translation Messaging App
positions.description:
▶ Created a modularized web server by utilizing Express.js due to its powerful ability to chain middleware for reusable functionality, implement routing, and gather related middleware in controllers, embracing the model-view-controller pattern

▶ Established a Websocket library to develop consistent communication between clients and the server which enabled a low latency, bidirectional, event-based communication protocol, reducing unnecessary network traffic and allowing for a higher amount of efficiency compared to REST because they do not require the HTTP request/response overhead for each message sent and received

positions.title: Weather App 2.0 || Customizable Weather Web Application
positions.description:
▶ Coordinated dynamic, client-side navigation using React Router to login, signup, and dashboard pages, reducing page refreshing and programmatically manipulating the browsers’ history stack

▶ Implemented Jest unit tests on legacy code to develop understanding of the flow, determine if the Redux reducer was properly updating state to persist weather location, and analyze if the actions were dispatching correctly before confidently implementing new features like automatically generating user weather immediately upon successful login 

▶ Enlisted Express.js to establish a server, routing to APIs, and chain middleware functions because it is scalable, embraces the model-view-controller architecture, and supports caching features as opposed to other Node.js frameworks, making the back end faster.

▶ Authenticated users whose passwords were encrypted using bcrypt hashing by storing the password with a unique salt, which defends against dictionary attacks  by being computationally expensive to decrypt
